name: Forte Metals
verdict: Forte Metals saw zero paid activity across Meta and Google Ads in the last 28 days, making Google Business Profile the sole source of engagement with 85 total actions (including 9 calls, 53 direction requests, and 23 website clicks). GBP actions dropped 26.92% in the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days, likely reflecting reduced organic search demand or a seasonal dip in local intent.

performance.verdict: GBP is the only active channel; 3 overdue CRM milestones now block pipeline integrity.

findings.text: 1st Directives (Jul 7), Tom call list (Jul 28), and dedup workbook + 126 accounts (Jul 31) — 3 CRM milestones overdue by up to 55 days with no completion event recorded.
Zero paid spend across Meta and Google Ads for all 28 days in window; $0 CPL is meaningless — there is no active paid acquisition for this client.
GBP actions fell -26.92% week-over-week; 3-day signal (Aug 28–30) shows 10, 0, 0 actions vs prior 3 days (Aug 25–27) averaging 1.67 — sharp trailing drop.
Search clicks doubled (+100% 7d delta) with 34 clicks and 2,006 impressions over 28 days, but GA4 sessions are zero — tracking is broken or GA4 is unlinked.
